reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but re-derives the daily-skip decision instead of extracting it from getUpcomingDates into a shared function.

duplication.why: The `config.skipWeekend && config.frequency === 'daily'` predicate is copied verbatim from getUpcomingDates and the skip-or-move branch is rewritten as a loop, so the weekend rule now has two copies in the same file (plus getNextDate).

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like the other handlers.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and correct-looking, but the next weekend-rule change must be applied to getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange separately; config is untyped.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared adjust-occurrence abstraction existed to go around; it calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the moving case.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's for-loop with continue/else-if reshapes getUpcomingDates' ternary filter/map skip-vs-move logic
